name: ProSeller AI – Product Content Creator and Optimizer for WooCommerce (No API Required)
author: storepro

sections.description:
No API keys. No complex setup. 500 free credits every month.

🌟 ProSeller AI is the fastest and easiest way to generate product content that sells. ProSeller is the only AI product content plugin for WooCommerce that doesn’t require your own API key.
Get 500 free AI credits every month – no setup headaches, no extra costs. Just install and start generating high-converting product content in seconds, individually or in bulk.

Try it today and see the impact of smarter content on your WooCommerce store.

ProSeller AI uses powerful Artificial Intelligence to create SEO-optimized product titles, descriptions, short descriptions, and variation content—all designed to increase visibility and boost sales.

🌟Key Benefits

  • Fast and Simple Content Creation
  • Improve Existing Descriptions Easily
  • Create missing content – like Short Descriptions
  • Experiment with better descriptions
  • Improve SEO with optimised Content
  • Amend product descriptions to target your specific audience
  • Try different styles of writing to suit your audience

What Makes ProSeller AI Different?

🎁 Free Credits Every Month – No Strings Attached
Unlike other plugins that require you to have your own API key, ProSeller AI gives you 500 free credits per month with no need to bring your own API key or pay upfront. It’s the easiest way to start using AI for your WooCommerce store.

Need more credits? Flexible plans are available as your store grows.

✅ Instant AI-Powered Content Generation
Create SEO-friendly product titles, descriptions, short descriptions, and variation content based on your chosen keywords.

🎯 SEO-Optimized Content
The product content and decsriptions created are designed to be accurate and SEO optimized.

✅ Rewrite & Optimize Existing Content
Improve your current titles and descriptions using AI suggestions.

✅ Bulk Product Generation Made Easy
Create (or improve) 1000’s of products descritptions, short descriptions and product titles in one easy operation.

✅ AI-Powered Content That Converts with Audience control
Choose your target audience, tone and style of content so that the decriptions created are a hit with your specific audience.

✅ Formatting Control
Choose your desired description format. Pragraphs only or paragrpahs with feautres listed in bullet points.

✅ Field-Specific Control
Choose which parts of your product content to generate or update (title, short description, etc.).

✅ Built for WooCommerce
Designed specifically for WooCommerce stores to simplify product content creation.

🔒 Secure
We do not store or share any of your generated content.

Pro Version Available

The pro version of our plugin offers the following

🚀 Use Your Own API Key
If you have an existing API key with Open AI you can use this key instead of ProSeller Credits. Your own Open AI account will be billed for generated content.

🚀 Increased Credit Plans
Get up to 10,000 credits by using one our pro subscriptions, no need for your own API – Contact Us for more details.

🚀 Directly influence the next features released
Our pro users will help us to decide the next feature we release and will get first access.

🚧 Coming Soon

SEO Meta Description Generation
Improve your SEO by creating accurate meta descriptions instantly.

A/B Testing for Descriptions
Test multiple versions of a product description to find the highest converting content.

A/B Image Testing
Find the highest converting image for your products by testing various versions of your product image.

Profitability Optimizer
Get pricing suggstions and A/B test pricing to find the most profitable price for your products.

Competitor Tracking
Track competior prices and more.

Tag Generation
Generate Products Tags to improve product search.

Related Products
Auto connect related products in your catalog to improve product suggestion to your customers

Auto Audience Targeting
A/B test product descriptions based on your target audience. ProSeller will automatically discover the your audience and tune the content to match.

Support for Multiple AI Models
Choose your preferred AI provider beyond OpenAI.

Targeted Descriptions by Region
Customize language and tone based on geographic audience.

Lots more features are on their way!

🔒 Disclaimer

ProSeller AI is a conversion optimization plugin that helps you connect to AI services without needing to have your own API Key. All plugin data is stored securely on your WordPress server. Content is generated by Open AI, we do not store any of your content. Always follow your local regulations and consult legal professionals if needed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-product-content-creator-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under ‘Proseller AI’ in the admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

You can generate product content by navigating to the product edit page.

Where can I get support?

Support is available through the plugin support page.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is free to use with 500 monthly credits that automatically renew each month. If you need additional credits, you can upgrade to the PRO version for more flexibility and features.

Do I need an API Key?

No, you don’t need an API key to use the plugin. However, if you upgrade to the PRO version, you have the option to use your own OpenAI API key if needed.

Does the Plugin only work on WooCommerce Products?

Yes, we focus on eCommerce and this plugin focuses on improving your products for better sales and conversions.
sections.changelog:
1.5.4

  • Introduced free credits for content generation, allowing users to generate content without an API key in the free version.
  • Removed the manual API key configuration for free users.
  • Enhanced the settings page with dedicated options for Free and PRO users.

1.5.3

  • Bug Fix

1.5.2

  • Optimized prompt structure.
  • Optimized customization options.

1.5.1

  • Bug Fix

1.5

  • Introduced new customization options for content generation, allowing users to tailor the tone, style, and audience of the product descriptions.
  • Added the ability to select different description formats, such as bullet points, paragraphs, or paragraphs with bullet points, to better suit your product presentation needs.

1.4

  • Plugin Renamed into ProSeller AI – AI Product Content Creator and Optimizer for WooCommerce.

1.3

  • Added batch processing for product content generation to avoid server overload.
  • Added error display for Cloudflare 504 timeout errors.
  • Improved handling of AJAX requests with retry mechanism and exponential backoff.

1.2.1

  • Display API errors on frontend during bulk content generation.
  • Removed hiding of the prompt field from the “content to generate” field, allowing regeneration of the same field content using previous content as a prompt.
  • Added console log and debug log enable/disable options in settings.

1.2.0

  • Introduced Bulk Content Creation on the WooCommerce product listing page.
  • Select multiple products and click “Generate Contents Using AI” to create content.
  • Choose specific fields as prompts and define which fields to generate (title, description, short description).
  • Automatically saves the generated content for the selected products.
  • Enhanced content generation for higher efficiency in product content creation.

1.1.0

  • Fixed issues with adding new products.
  • Added feature to generate new title, description, and short description from existing content.
  • Rewrote existing product variation’s description.
  • Tested with WordPress 6.7 and WooCommerce 9.4.1.
  • Verified compatibility with PHP 8.3.11.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
